bootstrap_selection_rules.sampling: sample N user IDs with replacement from the N observed users in each split
bootstrap_selection_rules.cluster_contents: all impressions and target occurrences of each selected user share its multiplicity
bootstrap_selection_rules.class_universe: fixed before bootstrap: validation support>=20; Dev observed supported classes
bootstrap_selection_rules.missing_class_rule: in each draw, average paired class differences over originally eligible classes with positive drawn support; identical class set for all arms
bootstrap_selection_rules.empty_draw_rule: omit draws with zero eligible classes from percentile intervals; count them; do not replace draws
bootstrap_selection_rules.draw_sharing: all three contrasts use exactly the same draws within a split
bootstrap_selection_rules.interval: two-sided 95% percentile interval, numpy quantile linear interpolation
